This is my... home - or at least it has been for half a year.
The Endless Rain never stops, and sea level just keeps rising...
If I have to relocate all the time, can I really call this place home?

Well, I can survive anywhere - as long as Master Orlan and Lulua are with me!
Power — (?ω?)!
db/pnode/ch0-loc-memory-street/descripti:
I've seen a place like this before, not so long ago.
The sun hangs high in the sky, its warmth radiating down on me.
I can feel the sun shining in my heart.

How... how long has it been?
Did a time like this ever exist? Or... or is it just a fantasy?
db/pnode/ch0-loc-school/description:
This big room with nice appliances is where Hoppe and I took cooking class.
Our own kitchens, provided by the government, are too small to cook anything delicious.
I promise I don't mind washing dishes!

We used to cook dinner here to take home after school.
Well, Hoppe cooked - I helped by turning on the dishwasher!
db/pnode/ch0-loc-station/description:
Aquaria's spaceport.
The first time I came here, it was to watch Hoppe leave.
The second time…

Just thinking of that vile slime's face is enough to get my blood boiling.
Speaking of which, I still need to finish writing that formal complaint...
db/pnode/ch0-loc-street/description:
I always take this street right outside my apartment building,
no matter where I'm going - school, the store, you know. 

It isn't covered, so I'd be soaked to the bone if it weren't for my rain shield.

Ugh... Nothing is more annoying than the constant pitter-patter of raindrops.
db/pnode/ch2-loc-desert/description:
The desert is vast.
Like Aquaria's rains,
its blowing yellow sands can be seen dancing in the air, heard crashing into other objects,
and even felt flowing into my lung with the air when I breathe.

...

How is it? I'm pretty good with words, right?
--I won't tell you it was Hoppe's words.
db/pnode/ch2-loc-inn/description:
The most popular inn in Geo Village
is run by the beautiful Kakari and her husband Rumil.
Although everyone in the village calls Rumil the innkeeper,
he is just a helper, and Kakari is the real owner of the inn.
db/pnode/ch2-loc-village/description:
The nearest village to Orb Spaceport.
The majority of buildings are made of rocks and various refined metals.
It's a village, but it's almost as big as the city I live in.

Its market is big and lively every day,
and most of the specialties I bought for my friends are here!
db/pnode/ch2-loc-workshop/description:
In Geo Village's Ore Workshop,
raw ores are refined into gems and metals.
It typically processes Rockfall Ore, which is found in the recently emerged Falling Rocks.

...

It is said that many people tragically died in the first few days after Falling Rocks first appeared because they were unaware of this sudden disaster.

The large ore is also known as Dead Ore because of this.
db/pnode/ch3-loc-bridge/description:
From south to north, there is a wide bridge across the massive river encircling the planet.
The bridge connects the east and west banks, serving as the only land route between the elf and human settlements.
db/pnode/ch3-loc-forest-in/description:
The depths of the Elf Forest.
Due to the tense relationship between elves and humans, very few humans can access here.
db/pnode/ch3-loc-forest-out/description:
The outskirts of the Elf Forest.
During the daytime, visitors of any race are free to enter for sightseeing.
For evening visits, prior application and permission are required.
db/pnode/collab_arcaea-loc-carnival/desc: A public square located in the D-11 region, which is the center of the Floating Island archipelago. It features various large shopping centers and entertainment facilities and often hosts a variety of events.
db/pnode/collab_arcaea-loc-riverside/des: A scenic bridge near the Radiant Arc Garden. Its main attraction is a floating river, created using expensive imported magic stones combined with Aquarian technology.
db/pnode/event_summer25-vn-m6/title: The truth of "he Grand Finale Event"
db/song/atropos-and-the-final/name-trans: Atropos and Seeker of the End.
db/song/azurite/composer-note:
"Azurite" is a UK Hardcore-inspired track that imagines what the color azurite would sound like. Its iconic fast-paced four-on-the-floor rhythm, together with complex and catchy Drum 'n Bass elements, will definitely get you hyped.


Every element in "Azurite" is placed, processed and arranged in oksuu style. I hope you enjoyed the song, as much as I did when I was working on the song!
db/song/bassline-yatteru-lol/name-transl: Can I Friend You on Bassbook? lol
db/song/beat-rise/composer-note: Beat Rise is a hypothetical song that imagines how a scientist might describe soul music as it evolves by incorporating various elements from past to future. It's a tropical and pop-oriented music that blends elements of soul, funk, and Latin music.
db/song/cataclysm/composer-note:
Things that stir up and mislead this untainted present
To the darkness peeking out from the cracks
The captive heart sways, wanders, and falls

What was endlessly connected is swallowed by blackness day by day and vanishes
Overlapping and muddying impulses
The guidance to simply stand and resist

I must move on, to get it back.

The dream I held high, dream, shake off the hesitation and anguish
Thoughts flow endlessly, to rule the white of someday

In the space between lies and reality, if it is a world dyed in lamentation
With those unclouded eyes, project righteousness right here

A fleeting dream, dream, cast away the unreachable sorrow
Thoughts flow endlessly, to rule the white of someday
Until I conquer
db/song/centimental/composer-note:
"[C]ENti:mentAL" blends ethereal Botanica textures, IDM rhythms, and experimental sound design to create a dreamlike yet grounded soundscape. Inspired by cultural festivals and celestial myths, the track moves between moments of serene reflection and powerful emotional swells, capturing the beauty of connection between the living and the departed.  

This song is inspired by the Tanabata Sky Lantern Festival, the myth of Orihime/Hikoboshi, the Chinese Lantern Festival. It's sung from the perspective of a deity returning to the site where lanterns are sent into the sky, carrying wishes to those who have passed. The deity witnesses the hopes of the living and promises to see them again when it's time to reunite in the afterlife, where their wishes will be received.
db/song/dawn-nymphaea/composer-note:
This is a piano rock instrumental themed around the Five Elements concept of water begetting wood, with a blue water lily rising from the deep, black bottom of the water as its central motif. Surrounded by spirits of water, I shaped the song around the image of life force overflowing like the light of dawn.


As for the title, “Nymphaea” is the scientific name for the water lily, and it derives from the water spirit “ニンフ”. In addition, the blue water lily that blooms in the morning and closes at night is said to have symbolized the sun and rebirth in ancient Egypt, so I included that imagery as well when naming it “Dawn Nymphaea”.
db/song/dazzrite/composer-note:
This is a J-Core / UK Hardcore track created around the fictional newly discovered mineral “Dazzrite”.


I aimed to create a catchy, refreshing track that would leave a lasting impression on many players.
I also infused it with the essence of the doujin music scene from 2010 to 2015, which had a strong influence on me, while consciously pursuing a sound design with a touch of nostalgia.
db/song/forward-motion/composer-note:
An upbeat tune, but with a slightly melancholy tone to it. It blends together some influences from future bass, jazz, glitch hop, house, & world music. "Forward Motion" is primarily about the feeling of pushing yourself forward toward a goal. Sort of touching on how I feel lost without a sense of something driving me. Always chasing something, but on my own terms. The line at the end "forward motion can push me till I break" touches on how that feeling can easily become too much of a focus. Almost like tunnel vision, but looking to the future. Ultimately it's something I find very important- but can easily take over to where you forget to look at what's in front of you.

I really enjoy how this song doesn't really have anything that repeats the same way within the song. It encapsulates that feeling of moving forward that the song's about. The song's key & chord progression feels fun, while maintaining a sort of serious undertone. Really reinforcing the main theme being something that's positive, but can become negative at times. I think a lot of the staccato sounds sprinkled throughout help the song feel like it's propelling you forward.
db/song/fractured-skies/composer-note:
Hype Moments and Aura. A fleeting feeling of a burden unlifted as the last humanity hope at in a conflict. A conflict both between what's happening in the world and also within themselves. Whether they want to stay and fight or succumb to a quick end. Waiting for the call and the final messenger to call their name out. 

Flay!
“Hope you all having fun playing our song!”
Xia
“Hi everyone!! I'm excited for you all to play our song - I had so much fun creating it with Flay and Yoominel. Please look forward to many epic moments!”
Yoomniel
“Thank you for listening, I hope you like playing the song!”
db/song/full-circle/composer-note:
"Full Circle" a genre-blending combination from electronic, hyper & rock, more towards J-Rock and punk arrangement-style. 
Influencing a full core representation of all the music I passionately enjoy, and also grew up with. 
A musical piece portraying straight-to-the-face hyper punk energy, with strong sense of love and passion of being in the world of arts and creativity, especially involving in the world of music.

To give a full analogy idea, music is like a full circle, for example, rotational trending music, one comes another and a few years later, nostalgia sound comes right back like a full circle. 
Same goes to show a perfect portray with all the amazing list of music that I have looked up in about Rotaeno, along with it's gameplay in a shape of a circle.
db/song/hearts-station/composer-note:
Heart's Station is song about traveling far away on a train with a long-time friend. It portrays the feeling that with them, no matter the plan, you are always bound to have a good time.

"Hi, it's PSYQUO. I did the composing, arrangement and production for Heart's Station! While trying to conceptualize the track, I was thinking about what "free-spirited and playful hipster ojisan" would sound like as a track itself. I thought "maybe something like breakbeat with a bit of rap" would fit well. "Some train sound effects could fit too" so I added it all over the song to emphasize Mr. Slime being a train station master. I always thought guitar solos in rhythm game tracks are really cool so it also had to have that too. We can't forget Skye's amazing work with the lyrics and vocals that really tied the song together.
I hope everyone opens their Heart's Station! "
- PSYQUO

“Skye-a! Thank you all so much for listening to and playing our song! I’m Skye Senfort, the lyricist and singer for the track composed by my friend and amazing composer, PSYQUO! I think my main inspiration for the lyrics was researching Ilot’s story as much as I could, as well as the info we were given on Mr. Slime! And the quality of what I think is called “maemuki” (positivity?) and sincerity in JPop songs that I learned about when I and a few others were working with Nelson Babin-Coy (lyricist for many popular JPop artists) on a song at one point in my Vtubing career! I also tried to cram as much fun and puns in the lyrics as I could despite still learning Japanese— I hope you continue to enjoy both Rotaeno’s, PSYQUO’s, and my work!”

“スカイヤー みなさま！バーチャルユーチューバスカイセンフォートです、この曲の作詞・ボーカルを担当させていただきました。
作詞について、インスピレーションは、Ilot ちゃんの話、スライムさんの個性、そしてネルソン・バビン-コイさんから学んだ「前向きさ」と「誠実さ」です。ネルソンさんとは Vtuber 活動の中でご一緒させていただいたことがありました！
日本語はまだ勉強中なんですが、電車ダジャレをたくさん使って、できるだけ楽しい歌詞にしようと努力したので、楽しんでいただけたら嬉しいです！
みなさまが Rotaeno、PSYQUO さん、そして私の活動も応援してくれたらととっっっても嬉しくなります！これからもよろしくお願いします！”
- Skye Senfort
db/song/hushwave-symptoms/composer-note:
Go catch the twilight at the street corner.
我不想路过街边晕倒的霓虹
悄无声息地吞噬水洼的缺口
数不尽淹没多少声色的缄默
我不再挽留转角掠去的夜色

I don't want to pass by the neon lights slumped along the street,
that silently devours the edge of the puddles.
With an uncountable hush drowning the city's sights and sounds —
I will not try to hold back the night that sweeps past the corner.
db/song/ish/composer-note:
This track aims to quietly awaken the memories sleeping deep within the listener's heart. Through all emotions—joy, sorrow, and bittersweetness—it expresses the ephemeral connections of all things, which hold meaning precisely because they are not eternal.
Composer/Artist Note

natsume:
I aimed for a soundscape where delicate emotional fluctuations coexist with an expansive, grand sound. I hope this track will resonate and overlap with the emotional landscapes within each listener's heart.

alpha:
I expressed the preciousness and strength of endings and beginnings. I would be happy if this track helps you reminisce about various thoughts and memories.
Source
db/song/kenka/composer-note:
献花 is composed with a conscious theme of blooming and reincarnation throughout the entire track.
The first half develops from a muffled, enclosed atmosphere into a chorus that radiates warmth, and the flow accelerates through a dense and intricate progression.
At the end, accompanied by a gentle chorus that gives the impression of thinking of someone or offering them flowers, the track quietly comes to a close while leaving a slight sense of loneliness.

Expressing life and death felt quite heavy and challenging during production, but I think it settled into a beautiful form in the end.
On a side note, for example, even if a life withers away, if there is someone who still remembers the deceased and offers them flowers, that might be proof that they live on in memory despite no longer having life.
Therefore, if this track becomes a song that remains in everyone's memory, perhaps it can be said that this track is alive.
As for me, I just hope it lives on forever.
db/song/love-killer/composer-note:
THIS IS LOVE♡CORE

I am Tatsunoshin! I am delighted to have written a new song for Rotaeno! Please give it a try :)
db/song/meiseki-yume-nite/composer-note:
Hello, this is DJ Raisei.
Have you ever been curious about how a dream continues?
It would be wonderful to have a lucid dream at times like that,
but surprisingly, everyday life can be just as beautiful.
db/song/mendokusai-modo/composer-note:
Hello, Rotaeno's pilots! I'm Ponchi♪.
It's my first time contributing to Rotaeno as an arranger—working on Ilot's character song.

Things you have to do, things you want to do… even just getting out from under the blanket…
"Everything is just… such a hassle!!"

That's Ilot in full-on "super can't-be-bothered" mode—please look forward to her ultimate slacker anthem!
db/song/neural-rewind-protocol/composer-:
“Neural Rewind Protocol” is an instrumental track that merges high-intensity Drum'n Bass with the hypnotic atmosphere of Psytrance and the weighty textures of Dubstep.
It imagines a futuristic neural architecture where memories are reconstructed as flowing digital data, creating an expansive and emotionally charged cybernetic landscape.
The music unfolds as a majestic interplay between consciousness and technology — a vast network of light, information, and lingering memories resonating in harmony.

This track expresses the idea of memories being “decoded” and brought back into clarity within a digital neural system.
Every sonic layer was shaped to evoke the sensation of information traveling through a living circuit — structured, yet undeniably emotional.
My goal was to create a sonic world where technology does not replace humanity, but enhances the emotional core embedded within each memory."
db/song/oldschool-tentacles/composer-not:
This track was composed by Raimukun for Raimu-Ojisan (a.k.a. Mr. Slime), one of
the characters in Rotaeno, and it musically expresses his unique personality

through a rhythm game-style composition.

The genre is RALLYCORE, a hybrid form inspired by the recent underground Rally
House scene since 2024, mixed with rhythm-game-oriented J-core and various EDM

styles from the 1990s to the 2010s.

In the story, Raimu-Ojisan is portrayed as somewhat of a troublemaker, yet his
sly, humorous, and easygoing personality gives off the impression of a classic

middle-aged man.

This track began with the imaginative question:
“What if Raimu-Ojisan hosted a DJ event using his own slime body?”
Perhaps he would spin old-school tracks from the 1990s–2010s, throw around some
outdated memes, and pull off a few trollish antics on stage.
That playful idea became the foundation of this song.
db/song/piper-hyper-caravan/composer-not:
Piper Hyper Caravan is a wildly energetic ethno hardcore track packed with ethnic sounds and nonstop motion.
There’s no plan, no brakes, and no time to think — just follow the piper and keep moving.

Made for Rotaeno with no complicated ideas — just speed, ethnic sounds, and nonstop motion.
Don’t stop, don’t wait, and don’t overthink it.
db/song/rainy-day/composer-note:
ag:
This house track was inspired by rainy afternoons in a coffeehouse. I hope you enjoy it while sipping a cup of hot cocoa.

倉先:
It would be awesome if this song could bring some wonderful moments to your day.
I hope you enjoy it!
db/song/rokutyounen/name-translation: Six Trillion Years and Overnight Story
db/song/seq-unleash-knockout/composer-no:
SEQ_UNLEASH: Knockout! is a high-energy hybrid track that blends retro video game soundfonts with modern TechCore, hardstyle and dubstep elements. Designed to evoke the spirit of a fighter arcade game, the song captures the raw intensity, rhythm, and excitement of fast-paced battles.
The composition moves through punchy VGM motifs, driving buildups, and explosive hardstyle drops, symbolizing the thrill of challenge and victory within the game world.

Composer/Artist Note
This song was composed exclusively for Rotaeno and inspired by the classic arcade fighters BGM style. I wanted to make a mix of nostalgic game music but with a more aggressive EDM style to create a unique vibe and make the player immersed in the level.
I think this song is a great example of how a more 16-bit style Techfont track would sound.
I sincerely hope you enjoyed listening to the music!
db/song/serendipity/composer-note:
A song themed around “turning misfortune into fortune,” featuring lyrics and an upbeat
arrangement of oldies music infused with elements of French pop and acid jazz.
db/song/silver-linings/composer-note:
"Silver Linings" -- a Midtempo Bass track that consists of various beautiful and epic
melodies lined with a solid synth drop. The track aims to express hope and positive
feelings.
db/song/stolen-lips/composer-note:
“Was it only her lips that were stolen?
Words coming across them are no longer faith.”
「盗まれたのは、唇だけですか？
その唇から発せられる言葉も、もう信じない」


Having long aspired to compose the most alluring and sensual piece in the history of music rhythm
games, I chose to undertake this experiment with the distinguished honour of my first work for
Rotaeno.
Rather than shifting time signatures arbitrarily, I have imposed a logically structured grid upon the
melody. For instance, the chorus, composed of three measures in 7/4 time followed by a single
measure in 3/4 time, aggregates to 24 beats, thereby allowing it to be interpreted within the
framework of either triple or quadruple time space.
I wish to extend my profound admiration to Mr. Toshiro Mitsutomi for bringing this thrilling
composition to life with his flute, and to the string performers of L'ensemble de poche for their
invaluable contributions.
db/song/summer-time-memory/composer-note:
kanemiko:
Hello, this is kanemiko.
When I was approached by Rotaeno to write this song, I was really excited to get to work as this kind of summer song is one of my favorite styles!
I wrote this song to reflect how I feel about summer. This song feels happy but sad at the same time in a way I think a lot of people understand. Thanks to まより-san's wonderful lyrics, I think the theme has been expressed well. I hope everyone enjoys my first song in Rotaeno!

まより:
Hello, this is まより, the lyricist.
"Even if we forget parts of our past, it doesn't diminish us—because the experiences themselves are what shape who we are today." This is what I hope that my lyrics could express.
For students especially, summer often feels like a season of coming-of-age. The moments you gather then become the fuel that powers the journey ahead.
The melody struck me as deeply emotional, so I wrote a line like: "Even if the fresh feelings born of memories and experience fade as we grow up, summer will bring them back with its heat."
I hope this song brings you something warm this summer.
db/song/the-golden-heaven/composer-note:
This is a grand and beautiful orchestral track!

A journey across the seas of the farthest heaven.

Beyond the savage waves, the heart is stirred by the wondrous edifices of the gods.

At times, the journey wanders into a land of twilight.

Yet in the end, it arrives at the farthest sea—
where stars come to rest upon the surface of the ocean.

The most elegant and sweetest tale of adventure in the world.

—And when all is done, 'tis only the murmur of the sea that lingers.


I hope you can experience this golden voyage with us.

By the way, “rotation” in Japanese is expressed as kai-ten (回転),
and the idea was expanded by literally rotating that word to arrive at Ten Kai (天海).

The transformation itself isn’t meant to carry any meaning.
However, playing with sound and phonetics like this feels delightfully playful to me.

I would be truly happy if you enjoy this new story born from the world of Rotaeno.


Lastly, my deepest thanks to the Sound Team at Dream Engine Games for their dedication throughout the production.
This story would not have been possible without their support.

Fare you well, wayfarers.
db/song/tianlingling/name-translation: Tian Ling Ling Di Ling Ling
db/song/weaver-wanderer/composer-note:
After reading the story of Rotaeno, I created this track by expressing the sounds and vibes I felt from it.

I would be incredibly happy if you enjoy it. Thank you very much...!
db/song/windsurfer/composer-note: While writing "Windsurfer" I wanted to include all the sounds that I was familiar with and loved from my favourite artists, creating a sense of nostalgia while also putting a personal spin on each section. I think this contributes to its constant energy, with each drop producing a new feeling reflecting the various dimensions of summer.
db/song/within-the-horizon/composer-note:
“Within the Horizon” is a song about hopes and dreams. The high
energy, bright instrumentation, and optimistic melody all invite us
to follow our ambition and believe in a brighter future. Our dreams
are within our reach, within the horizon that we can see in the
distance.
db/song/yusui/composer-note:
This is a track where the genre changes dizzyingly with each section. While hopping between various genres, I wanted to unify the whole piece with an organic and refreshing sound, so I somehow managed to put it together while struggling quite a bit. The point I was particular about is that I almost entirely avoided using electronic music-style drums in the pop sections outside of the drops. I really felt how difficult mixing becomes without drums.
The title is read "Yusui," which refers to the weight on a metronome that determines the tempo. By the way, this is pretty irrelevant, but if you want to type the kanji for "錘" (weight), you can get it to convert on a Japanese keyboard by typing "omori". That really doesn't matter at all, I'm sorry.

*Mylta
I tried to be very particular about how each part develops, so I would be happy if you play it and listen to it a lot.
This time, I asked Kikuchi to do the vocals. Despite the extremely tight deadline, they responded very quickly, and I am incredibly grateful. Their voice tone and how they sang the different sections perfectly matched this track. Thank you so very much.

*菊植 (Kikuchi)
I'm Kikuchi, and I was in charge of the vocals.
For this colorful song where the genre constantly changes, when I was wondering how to sing it,I tried changing my mood by eating a different flavor of candy before recording each part! I hope you enjoy it!

event/rules/event-boss-every-{0}-pt-tick:

To take on the Boss, you need Boss Tickets. 1 Boss Ticket is awarded for every {0} PT earned from standard challenges. There is no cap on the number of Boss Tickets you can have, and they can only be used during this event.
In the Boss Challenge, Abyss HP is the only option and on several difficulties. On the first day, only the extreme HP (1HP) is available, which is the greatest difficulty, and very few players can defeat the Boss. The Challenger Badge can only be upgraded, which means that it will not be degraded by completing a lower-difficulty challenge.

tutorial/basic/catch-dont-have-to-tap:
You don't have to touch the screen for CATCH notes.
Please release your fingers.
tutorial/basic/catch/message/1:
The two white lines are the CATCH TRACK.
CATCH notes will travel along the track.
tutorial/basic/catch/message/2:
The CATCH AREA is on both sides of the JUDGEMENT RING.
The CATCH AREA will glow before a CATCH note appears.
tutorial/basic/catch/message/3:
Rotate your device so that CATCH notes land in the CATCH AREA.
Don't even tap - just rotate!

tutorial/basic/cha-slide-1/failed-hint:

tutorial/basic/cha-tap-1/failed-hint:

Try again!
tutorial/basic/clear-rate/message/1:

tutorial/basic/goodbye/message/1: Pause the game mid-song by tapping the combo indicator at the center of the screen.
tutorial/basic/goodbye/message/2:
That's all for this gameplay tutorial.

tutorial/basic/posture/message/1: It's finally time to try rotation controls!
tutorial/basic/posture/message/2: Before we start, make sure you're holding your device with both hands like a steering wheel.
tutorial/basic/posture/message/3:

Hold your device at a 30° angle or steeper.
tutorial/basic/rotate-1/message/1: Now it's time to introduce the most exciting note in Rotaeno - the ROTATE note!
tutorial/basic/rotate-1/message/2: As soon as the red ROTATE note hits the JUDGEMENT RING, quickly rotate your device clockwise!
tutorial/basic/rotate-1/message/3: For blue ROTATE notes, rotate your device counterclockwise!
tutorial/basic/rotate-2/message/1: Now do your best to hit alternating red and blue ROTATE notes!
tutorial/basic/rotate-dont-have-to-touch:

tutorial/basic/rotation-2/message/1: Isn't rotation fun? Let's try it again!

tutorial/basic/slide-1/message/1: When SLIDE notes reach the JUDGEMENT RING, tap and hold your finger on the screen!
tutorial/basic/slide-2/message/1: SLIDE notes are usually seen one after another in long chains, and appear in both Big and Small variants.
tutorial/basic/slide-2/message/2: Big and Small SLIDE notes only differ in appearance - hit them the same way!
tutorial/basic/slide-2/message/3:
Just tap and hold through the entire chain of SLIDE notes!
There's no need to tap each note.
tutorial/basic/tap/message/1:

tutorial/basic/tap/message/2: Once a TAP note reaches the JUDGEMENT RING, tap it!
